training.unchanged_winner_policy: reload the selected checkpoint and perform one fresh post-selection test evaluation; retain the historical measurement separately as reused evidence

execution.device_policy: fixed before preflight: H2GCN uses CPU for every dataset and condition; its CUDA sparse.mm path lacks a strict deterministic-dispatch guarantee; no runtime fallback
execution.on_unsupported_deterministic_operation: fail; no warn-only mode, implementation substitution, or device fallback

published_diagnostics.graph_scope: train-induced simple undirected graph; remove loops and deduplicate only in diagnostic view
published_diagnostics.labels: training labels only; unavailable labels must not be inspected
published_diagnostics.empty_or_single_class_policy: undefined metric, explicit abstention and declared MLP fallback; retain unit in full-set loss
published_diagnostics.interpretation: published statistics with the present decision calibration, not a reproduction of a published end-to-end selector

calibration.candidate_thresholds: midpoints of distinct defined scores in training datasets, plus all-graph and all-MLP endpoints
calibration.tie_rule: smallest threshold among losses within 1e-12 of the minimum
calibration.target_source: selected-model test outcomes from other datasets are explicit meta-training targets
calibration.heldout_exclusion: held-out values and outcomes never choose threshold, direction, metric or portfolio

analysis.original_h1_calibration: unchanged original grid; do not silently replace existing LODO with midpoint search
analysis.optimistic_bound: optional complete test-selected threshold-family lower bound, labelled post-hoc and never a deployed-policy estimate
analysis.reporting: all planned conditions, budgets, metrics and portfolios; no selection by outcome
analysis.uncertainty: descriptive dataset-level paired differences and intervals; no new confirmatory superiority claim
analysis.exclusions: inherit only the two pre-existing dataset-exclusion sensitivities

budget.reused_training_charge: already charged in base evidence; do not charge historical training twice
budget.new_training_charge: all setup, additional training, save and validation time; failures and retries accumulate with corresponding original dataset/condition/MLP unit and dataset/seed/MLP pair
budget.authorization_scope: additional published diagnostics and 24-trial MLP grid approved 2026-09-28; no increase to existing total or subbudgets
budget.incremental_segments: Every subsequently created supplement segment must be included in the shared append-only inventory before a later handoff; inherited use cannot be omitted.

launch_gates: all prior attempts reviewed and trusted ledger heads bound
remaining cumulative caps cover bounded estimate
isolated end-to-end fixture passes actual training and reload
same execution SHA has all three unique completed successful CI jobs in one run
task-scoped sleep prevention and continuous supervisor active
exclusive execution; base research process has exited

runtime_controls.normal_pause: finish and save the complete 24-trial model unit, then stop dispatch
runtime_controls.emergency_stop: terminate owned worker immediately; preserve unfinished attempt; no automatic retry
